title: TH.AF.ALGN.------INFO.RT.
description: Chart on book p. 451 (TRF(CW)-23). TH-AF-ALGN (thrust affinity alignment) is the subject; INFO-RT (information reality) is the partner. From the subject: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics), AFL (affinity alignment) and PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance). From SPT-DY: POST (postulation). From AFL: PHY-U-C (physical universe context). From PHY-U-C: RT-ALGN (reality alignment) and VT-PLT (vibrational platform). From VT-PLT: TR-INFO (trans-information). From PROJ-CONT: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics).
